params.body:
## Why

With the stocklist integration on a showroom is 630 slides, and every "Opnieuw maken" drew all of them again at about half a second each: five minutes for a zip that, but for a few prices, was yesterday's.

## What changed

- **`ShowroomSlide::fingerprint(Vehicle, Dealer, lang)`**: sha1 of `SLIDE_VERSION` plus every input `render()` reads: primary photo path and `media_version`, make, model, first registration year, fuel name, mileage, the price as shown (`CustomerModePrice::showroomPrice`), the lease banner (vehicle qualifies and dealer shows lease), the warranty fields, the dealer's name, address, logo path and VAT, and the language. Pure. Inputs the slide does not draw (transmission, power, colour) are left out on purpose: a change there would only cost a redraw that shows nothing new. Bump `SLIDE_VERSION` when the layout changes and every slide is drawn again once.
- **`ShowroomSlideCache`** (new, `App\Support`): the rendered JPEG on the `vehicles` disk under `_afgeleid/showroom/{vehicle_id}/{hash}.jpg`, the same `_afgeleid` convention as `VehicleImageService`. `slide()` returns the cached bytes when the hash exists, else renders, stores (immutable cache headers, like the derived photo sizes) and deletes the vehicle's older hashes. A cache write that fails is reported, never a lost slide.
- **`BuildShowroomZip`** takes its slides through the cache; the state counts `reused` and `drawn`, `forScreen()` exposes them, and the ready button reads "Downloaden (630 slides, 612 hergebruikt, 43 MB)" (nl/fr/en/de key `showroom.download_reused`, shown only when something was reused).
- **`stocklist:showroom-zip-prune`** (hourly, unchanged schedule) also removes `_afgeleid/showroom/{id}/` for vehicles that are sold, soft-deleted or gone; a bucket that cannot be listed is a reported warning, not a failed sweep.
- Rule S2-7.16 gets the caching sentence.

Not done: the bonus public `GET showroom/slide/{...}.jpg` route; left as an open point so this lands today.

## Measured

40-vehicle demo set (seeded dealer plus 38 clones, real `ShowroomSlide`, local `vehicles` disk): first run 40 drawn in 14.63 s, second run 0 drawn, 40 reused in 0.54 s.

## Tests

`ShowroomSlideTest` +2: same inputs give the same hash, a change of any drawn input (mileage, price, year, warranty, make, model, fuel, photo path, photo media_version, language, dealer name, street, logo, the lease banner) gives a new one, an undrawn field does not; a bare vehicle has a fingerprint. `ShowroomDownloadTest` +3: a second build renders nothing (spy renderer: 2 calls after two builds), reuses every slide and the zip is complete; a changed vehicle is drawn again and its stale hash removed; the sweep removes the folders of a sold, a deleted and an unknown vehicle and keeps the unsold one. Status shape assertions extended with `reused`/`drawn`. Run: `ShowroomDownloadTest`, `ShowroomSlideTest`, `ScheduleTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `LanguageParityTest`: plus `SettingsPhoneLayoutTest`: 49 tests, 280 assertions, OK (1 pre-existing incomplete).

## Screenshots

Ready state with the reused count at 1440 and 390, on a local server. No hot shared files touched. Rebased on main after #511 (cancel) merged; replaces #512. The stop check before each slide stays and the cache hit path still counts `reused`; rule S2-7.16 carries both sentences.
params.title: Showroom slides are cached by content hash; a rebuild draws only what changed (rebased, replaces #512)
